title: Luxuriously Roasted Syrian Lamb Pasta
description: A rich and flavorful Syrian dish featuring roasted lamb and pappardelle pasta, perfect for a special occasion. This recipe is carefully crafted to be onion and garlic free.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb shoulder with salt, black pepper, and sumac.
Place the lamb shoulder in a roasting pan and roast for 20 minutes per pound, or until the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the lamb is roasting, cook the pappardelle pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil and lemon juice.
Add the cooked pappardelle pasta to the bowl and toss with the olive oil and lemon juice mixture.
Once the lamb is done, let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Add the sliced lamb to the pasta and toss to combine.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
